reviewer_findings.finding: Client.query also reads a potentially1MiB frame with only an idle3s socket timeout; a slow fake endpoint can delay rejection. Current localhost/endpoint custody narrows reach; general cross-host service remains open.

A new commit() call after an already committed but lost acknowledgement queries the latest tip and may create the next sequence for identical opaque states. Do not claim exactly-once public checkpoint API or infer semantic monotonicity.
Suffix or complete rollback of witness storage is outside independently retained witness custody. The chain alone is not an external rollback anchor.
Witness CAS serializes commits, but there is no multi-actor lifecycle lease; do not turn sequential trusted-coordinator tests into a concurrent-owner guarantee.
